subject: Future Tech
title: Anthropic and Safety-First AI
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Anthropic and Safety-First AI.

hook.text: Anthropic was founded by ex-OpenAI researchers who left over safety concerns.

buildup.text: Claude, Anthropic's model, uses Constitutional AI and extensive red-teaming.

discovery.text: Anthropic's interpretability research aims to understand what happens inside neural networks—opening the black box.

twist.text: But Anthropic also raises billions and races to build frontier models.

climax.text: Anthropic argues building safe AGI requires being at the frontier. You can't align systems you haven't built.

punchline.text: Move fast and don't break everything. That's the safety-first bet.

quiz.question: Why did Anthropic's founders leave OpenAI?
options: They had concerns about AI safety practices
They wanted to build a social media company
